design.name: 旱魃·日轮
design.role: 部件；Unity 资产 SM_BossPart_HanbaSunRing，挂 socket_sunring
design.brief: Ba's colossal sun wheel, modelled separately: it floats behind her back and swings in front of her as a shield.
design.turnaround_lead: the drought goddess's colossal white-gold sun wheel (日轮) on its own
design.turnaround_pose: , standing upright on its edge with its front face toward the viewer: a big flat round wheel, a thick outer ring band carved with a simple Dunhuang flame-and-cloud relief, 24 chunky triangular flame-ray points around the outer rim, eight straight spokes to a round domed central hub, open gaps between the spokes; white-gold and pale gold with warm amber shading in the recesses, the same colours and stylization as the sun wheel on the design sheet, chunky simplified game-art forms with clean bevelled edges; the back face is the same wheel with a plainer relief. MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light, no bloom, no halo, no light spill, no light rays, no heat haze, no sparks, no fire, no dust: matte flat opaque paint only
design.turnaround_digits: The whole wheel, every ray point and the hub fully inside the frame; in the side views the thin edge profile (about one fifteenth of the diameter) with the domed hub sticking out on both faces must be clearly readable.
